abstract: Wölbert et al. established a strategy that integrated conserved cell-type-specificity with conservation of transcriptional levels to identify robust signature genes. By leveraging evolutionary conservation as an additional dimension of cell identity, this strategy would facilitate cell identity annotation across species, particularly in non-model organisms and rare cell populations.
